questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Lions or Dragons?
At which ground did Eastern Storm record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 90, against Limpopo Lillies on 2013/10/12.

questions.question: Laura Wolvaardt became the first South African woman to reach 5,000 ODI runs. In how many innings did she reach the milestone, the second-fastest ever?
questions.explanation: Wolvaardt reached 5,000 ODI runs in 117 innings, second only to India's Smriti Mandhana (112 innings).

questions.question: At Recreation Ground, who holds the record for 'Most Runs' (T20)?
At which ground did Joline Smit record their career-best innings (55, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Willowmoore Park Main Oval, against Tuskers on 2022/10/02.

questions.question: How many sixes separate the all-time #1 (Anneke Bosch) and #2 (Yolandi Potgieter) six-hitters (T20) in the 19/20 season?
questions.explanation: Anneke Bosch: 5 — Yolandi Potgieter: 4 — a gap of 1.
